hints.tr: `max` kullanmadan, `if` / `elif` / `else` ile dene: önce `x > y`, sonra `y > x`.
hints.en: Try it without `max`, with `if` / `elif` / `else`: first `x > y`, then `y > x`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
x = int(input("x: "))
y = int(input("y: "))
if x > y:
    print(x)
elif y > x:
    print(y)
else:
    print("equal")
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
x = int(input("x: "))
y = int(input("y: "))
if x > y:
    print(x)
elif y > x:
    print(y)
else:
    print("equal")
```
